Who we are

A Welsh family business

Family business  ·  Commercial grade quality  ·  UK and Ireland installation

A Welsh family business with woodworking in our blood, building bespoke outdoor saunas since day one. Every sauna is made to order, delivered and installed across the UK and Ireland.

Made to orderEvery sauna is made to order. Choose your length, diameter and layout.
Built to lastThermowood is heat treated timber that resists moisture, warping and decay.
Based in WalesBuilt in the same workshop as our saunas, same joinery, same attention to detail.

Already running on our saunas

Real venues, real bookings

Sauna Snug at Flynn Park · Co. Dublin
A family adventure park running since 1996 added barrel saunas with a spring fed lake dip. Public sessions for up to eight, private hire for one to eight, open seven days a week.
Other real life examples
Escape to the Sauna · Cornwall
3.5m trailer sauna, wood burner, half moon window, by the water.
Surf South West · Devon
5m trailer sauna, panoramic window, solar lighting. Beaches, events and retreats.

What to put on your site

Everything guests book

Barrel saunaFixed on a base or decking. Built on site by our team.
Mobile saunaMove it, hire it out, take it to events. Our own Welsh built trailers.
Hot tubsPairs with the sauna for a hot and cold session. Wood fired or electric.
Ice bathsCold to go with the hot. A single plunge or the Double Dipper for two.
Double DipperSauna and plunge on one deck. Hot and cold in one bookable session.
Barrel showersRinse off between hot and cold. Easy to keep clean.
Shepherd's hutsExtra bookable stays, built in the same workshop.
Glamping podsOften need no planning permission.
Grill cabinsCovered seating and a fire in the middle. Open all year.
